tools.name: search
tools.description:
Default search for Swiss court decisions and case law on entscheidsuche.ch (Federal Supreme Court BGer/BGE and cantonal courts; German, French, Italian). Use this tool unless you need something specific.

Describe the legal question or the facts in natural language, in any language — the search work

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.description: AI search by meaning (semantic / embedding search) across Swiss court decisions on entscheidsuche.ch. Best for legal questions, descriptions of facts and concepts: write one or more full sentences instead of keywords, e.g. 'Can a landlord terminate the lease because his daughter wants to move in?'.

tools.name: keyword_search
tools.description: Exact keyword (full-text) search across Swiss court decisions on entscheidsuche.ch. Finds decisions that contain the given words. Use it for specific terms, statute articles, names, quoted phrases, complete result lists, sorting by date and pagination. For legal questions in natural language prefer

tools.name: search_by_case_number
tools.description: Look up Swiss court decisions by case number, docket reference or BGE citation, e.g. 'BGE 142 III 1', '5A_396/2015' or 'ZB.2021.48'. The reference is searched as an exact phrase; the decision itself normally comes first, followed by decisions that cite it. Check that court and date of the hit match

tools.name: fetch_document
tools.description: Fetch one Swiss court decision by its document ID and return its full text together with title, court, date and links. Use the `id` of a hit returned by one of the search tools. For very long decisions the text is capped at 100,000 characters; if `text_truncated` is true, the complete document is av

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one Swiss court decision by its document ID and return its full text together with title, court, date and links. Use the `id` of a hit returned by one of the search tools. For very long decisions the text is capped at 100,000 characters; if `text_truncated` is true, the complete document is av

tools.name: list_hierarchy
tools.description: Returns the hierarchy IDs of Swiss cantons, courts and chambers together with the number of decisions, optionally restricted to the decisions matching a keyword query. Use the IDs in the `hierarchy` filter of the search tools.

tools.name: list_facets
tools.description: Tree of all cantons, courts and chambers with their names in German, French and Italian. The `id` fields can be used in the `hierarchy` filter of the search tools.

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Version and configured endpoints of this MCP server for Swiss case law.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
